rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Short residential kerb with a house 8 m away and a steep grade.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes at 8 m and 13 m on the section's side, more all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb on a narrow residential street; only 11 m long, less than a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, a few cars parked.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb in places; houses on the west side.

best_section.where: West kerb of Fairley Street, outside the corner house
